core_obligations: Compute H^m(F^•(U)) as the cohomology of the four-term complex of limits in the third spot (proof lines 9934-9941).

Apply More on Algebra, Lemma apply-Mittag-Leffler-again using (2)(a) and (2)(b) to get H^m(F^•(U)) = lim H^m(F_n^•(U)), then use (2)(c) to get H^m(F^•(U)) = H^m(F_n^•(U)) for n ≥ n_0 (proof lines 9942-9951).
Sheafify over the basis using (1): the inverse system H^m(F_n^•) is constant for n ≥ n_0 with value H^m(F^•) (proof lines 9952-9960).
proof_roadmap: Compute the limit complex per open.
Identify with the limits of cohomologies via Mittag-Leffler.
Freeze values for n ≥ n_0 and sheafify.
